normal_reset_contract: Original per-operation reset semantics retained; arbitrary abort/reset recovery is not claimed.
limits: Two-state finite RTL KAT verification, not formal whole-design equivalence or FIPS certification.
Vivado FPGA synthesis and timing must be rerun on the corrected variant.
No ASIC startup changes; unsupported security levels remain unsupported.
unsupported_selector_behavior: Both corrected selector outputs are zero for unsupported binary or X/Z sec_lvl; cryptographic operations at these settings are not supported.
